answer: A concrete sybil defense is a refundable, time-locked identity bond. At the dawn of each account, the operator locks a plume of scarce collateral before the identity can vote or grade. Withdrawals unlock only after many epochs, and proven multi-identity cheating slashes the bond rather than returning it. Because the locked stake is as illiquid as buried shale, an attacker pays a linear, delayed cost per fake head that does not amortize when farming votes or jury seats.
